codeReview.summary: The migration covers the 7 targeted Node.js runtime files, preserves module boundaries/exports, and includes passing evidence for typecheck, unit tests, lint, build, and file-presence checks. I found no blocking defects.

issues.description: `SerializableEvent._serialize()` changed array traversal behavior from the prior JS implementation: it now enqueues `[array, index]` pairs via `.map((_value, index) => [value, index])` rather than `[element, index]`. This is likely an improvement, but it is still runtime behavior drift in a migration-focused feature and should be explicitly justified or covered by targeted parallel-serializer regression tests.
